inferred_requirements.justification: Directly stated in the prompt requirements.

inferred_requirements.title: Low-Level OS Window Focus and Kiosk Enforcement
inferred_requirements.description: The sandbox must maintain exclusive window focus and suppress system-level shortcuts (e.g., Alt+Tab, Win/Cmd keys, Mission Control) to prevent escaping the assessment environment.

Why 3: The sandbox must preserve strict foreground monopoly to ensure the test surface area remains completely isolated.
